parameters.query: SELECT ri.cluster_id, ri.priority_score FROM raw_items ri WHERE ri.id = $1
SELECT id FROM summary_cache WHERE cluster_id = $1 AND cache_type = 'cluster_summary' LIMIT 1
UPDATE raw_items SET pipeline_status = 'summarized' WHERE id = $1
SELECT ri.title, ri.excerpt, ri.full_text FROM raw_items ri WHERE ri.cluster_id = $1 AND ri.is_duplicate = false ORDER BY length(coalesce(ri.full_text, '')) DESC LIMIT 3

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, max_tokens: 1000, system: [{ type: 'text', text: $json.system_prompt, cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } }], messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.user_prompt }] }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE clusters SET summary_beginner = $1, summary_intermediate = $2, summary_expert = $3, summary_generated_at = now(), summary_model = $4, summary_cost_usd = $5, priority_score = LEAST(100, priority_score + $6), pipeline_status = 'summarized' WHERE id = $7

INSERT INTO summary_cache (cluster_id, cache_key, cache_type, content, model_used, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd) VALUES ($1, $2, 'cluster_summary', $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (cluster_id, cache_type, vertical_slug) DO NOTHING
UPDATE raw_items SET pipeline_status = 'summarized' WHERE id = $1
